jobs.title: Senior Planning Officer - Strategic Major Sites
jobs.description:
How you'll make a difference:

As Senior Planning Officer, you will take a lead role in delivering newly identified strategic development sites, helping to create thriving, sustainable communities for current and future generations. Working at the forefront of place\-making, you will ensure that new developments provide high\-quality environments, infrastructure and services that enable residents to live, work and enjoy.
The Planning Service is entering an exciting time for development with the draft Local Plan currently progressing through Examination in Public and anticipated to be adopted in 2027\. In addition, part of the district has been shortlisted for the Government’s New Town Programme.
What you will be doing:
* Acting as the lead officer for strategic development, you will project manage the applications for various sites.
* Providing technical expertise in the delivery of the council’s Major Sites planning and other corporate policy objectives, you will be involved with managing consultations, preparing reports and formulating well\-reasoned recommendations for determination in accordance with council policies, procedures and statutory requirements.
* You will support the development of junior colleagues, providing guidance, mentoring and regular opportunities for learning and professional growth through regular meetings, knowledge sharing and team training initiatives.
* It will be your responsibility to respond to enquiries, concerns, complaints and Freedom of Information requests, ensuring all matters are handled professionally, efficiently and in accordance with council procedures and timescales.
* Working as part of a multi\-disciplinary team, you will collaborate with planners, urban design officers, landscape architects, ecologists and public opens space officers.


What we need from you:
* You will hold a degree relative to town and country planning and be a full Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute or another relevant professional body.
* It is essential that you have experience of planning, managing and delivering work programmes within a planning or related service, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements and the successful achievement of service objectives.
* You must have a good knowledge of the relevant legislation and regulatory framework for the provision of the Strategic Major Sites service.
* We are looking for someone with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with experience of leading effective consultation and engagement activities involving representatives of the public, community groups, the business community and other interested parties.
* You will have experience of working collaboratively with applications and development partners through Planning Performance Agreements (PPAs).
* As this role involves regular travel across the district, you will need to hold a full, valid driving licence and have access to a vehicle or alternative means of travel.


What you need to know:
* You will be expected to travel throughout the authority and surrounding area so you must have a full, valid driving licence with regular access to a vehicle or have an alternative means of travel.
* This role is hybrid, with a mixture of working at our office in Yate and working from home.

 **Interviews date is to be confirmed.**
How a career at South Gloucestershire Council is different:
* We know our team work best when they have balance in their lives, and we offer genuine **flexibility** to help them achieve that **work/life balance**
* What’s special here is the strength of the **team ethos,** the support and the training.
* We recognise that our **diverse team** of skilled and dedicated people make us a great place to work. We welcome applications from everyone and ensure that individuals are selected, promoted and developed on the basis of their merits and abilities.

  

Our teams at South Gloucestershire Council are making a real difference to the lives of people who live, work and learn here.
* We're building and shaping communities which people are proud of.
* We're planning for the future; building and improving the roads, railways, schools, green spaces, and houses.
* We’re providing essential services across our communities to ensure they are safe and well maintained.

  

We've achieved a great deal, but we need talented and dedicated people to ensure we continue to make a difference.**We’re making a difference be part of it!**

jobs.title: Planning Officer - Policy
jobs.description:
Stockton\-on\-Tees Borough Council  

Career Grade I\-L \| Permanent \| 37 hours  

Salary £33,119 \- £45,529  

  

**Help shape the future of a diverse and ambitious borough.**  

  

Stockton\-on\-Tees Borough Council is seeking a talented and motivated Planning Officer to join its Planning Policy team.  

  

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in delivering the Councils strategic ambitions; supporting sustainable growth, regeneration and place\-making across a borough that offers a distinctive mix of urban, rural and coastal environments.  

  

**The Role**  

  

You will contribute to a broad range of planning policy work, including:
* Preparation, monitoring and review of the Local Plan and supporting evidence base
* Development of planning policy to support economic growth and regeneration
* Providing professional advice to colleagues, elected members and stakeholders
* Supporting consultation, engagement and examination processes.


  

This is a career grade post (I\-L), offering progression aligned to your qualifications, experience and professional development.  

  

**About You**  

  

We are looking for someone who:
* Has a relevant planning qualification (or is working towards one)
* Demonstrates knowledge of the planning system and policy framework
* Can analyse complex information and produce clear, high\-quality reports
* Works effectively both independently and collaboratively
* Is committed to shaping high\-quality, sustainable places
* RTPI accreditation (or working towards it) is welcomed.


  

**Why Stockton\-on\-Tees?**  

  

Stockton\-on\-Tees offers planners the opportunity to work on meaningful, place\-based challenges within a supportive and forward\-thinking local authority.  

  

You will join a service that values professionalism, collaboration and innovation, where staff are trusted, supported and empowered to make a difference.  

  

**Working Here**  

  

We recognise the importance of flexibility, wellbeing and professional growth. Our offer includes:
* Flexible and hybrid working options, supporting work\-life balance
* Generous annual leave of 27 days (rising to 32 after 5 years service) plus bank holidays
* Membership of the Local Government Pension Scheme
* Access to a wide range of training and development opportunities
* A comprehensive wellbeing offer, including confidential support services and online GP access.


  

For more information about working for Stockton\-on\-Tees Borough Council, please visit the Careers section on our website:  

  

Rewarding careers. We do that \- Stockton\-on\-Tees Borough Council  

  

**Interested?**  

For an informal discussion about the role, please contact:  

Simon Grundy, Planning Services Manager  

01642 528550  

simon.grundy@stockton.gov.uk  

  

**Please note that were unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role, so candidates will need to have an existing right to work in the UK.**  

  

**Important Applicant Guidance**  

  

**Accuracy and Use of AI Tools:** You must ensure that anything submitted in your application is factually accurate. Plagiarism can include presenting the ideas and experience of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own. Whilst we accept candidates may use AI tools within job applications; submissions must be truthful and relevant to your own experience.
  

  

**Application Updates and Communication:** All updates regarding your application, including interview invitations, will be sent from DONOTREPLY@NORTHEASTJOBS.ORG.UK to the email linked to your North East Jobs account, and will also appear in the My Messages section of your account.
  

  

**Right to Work:** All applicants must provide valid proof of their right to work in the UK in accordance with Stockton\-on\-Tees Borough Councils statutory employment checks. Employment cannot commence or continue unless this has been verified.
  

  

**Council Principles:** The Councils recruitment principles require fairness, transparency, and a commitment to attracting and developing local talent.
  

  

**Limitations:** Where an individual cannot demonstrate a valid right to work in the UK, the Council will be unable to progress or continue the appointment. This includes cases where an existing employees visa is due to expire and sponsorship is not granted.

jobs.title: Sr. Urban Designer | Urban, Campus & Cultural
jobs.description:
Overview:

At Corgan we are passionate about great design but the best thing we build is each other. Here, you’ll find camaraderie and collaboration as abundantly as curiosity and creativity. Corgan is a welcoming and supportive environment that provides significant career advantages. You’ll find room to grow, freedom to explore — and the safety to fail. Thank you for your interest in joining our curious, passionate, and hardworking team.  

Corgan is actively recruiting a dynamic **Senior Urban Designer** to join the growing **Urban, Campus \& Cultural** team. The Urban, Campus \& Cultural team brings together Cooper Robertson’s 45\-year legacy in urban design, campus planning, and cultural design with Corgan’s global platform. Corgan's Urban Design Studio partners with universities, public agencies, institutions, and private developers to create transformative plans for campuses, districts, mixed\-use communities, cultural destinations, and civic environments. Our work bridges strategy, design, and implementation. Work on diverse project types alongside a team of creative, highly motivated professionals who collaborate to deliver outstanding results. Our ideal candidate is enthusiastic about the team’s wide range of work and motivated to take on increasing responsibility to expand their expertise.
Responsibilities:
* Lead the development of master plans, feasibility studies, urban design frameworks, and other planning documents from concept through completion
* Develop compelling visual materials including diagrams, plans, renderings, digital massing models, and presentations to communicate design concepts and planning strategies
* Collaborate with architects, designers, planners, and multidisciplinary teams to create integrated, context\-sensitive design solutions
* Research zoning, land use, development patterns, mobility, and emerging urban design trends to inform project strategies and recommendations
* Lead the development of client presentations, workshops, stakeholder engagement, proposals, and other project communications
* Share knowledge, mentor emerging professionals, and contribute to the continued growth of Corgan’s urban design and planning practice


Qualifications:
* **This role is an in\-office position**
* Degree from a NAAB\-accredited architecture program or equivalent required
* 15\+ years of experience in urban design, planning, and architecture
* Professional registration in the US or actively pursuing registration
* The ideal candidate will be a team\-oriented, highly motivated individual seeking progressively more responsible assignments on a variety of projects
* Display strong design portfolio showing strengths in design, planning, and production
* Experience with Rhino and other 3D and GIS software preferred
* Strong organizational skills, written communication skills, and attention to detail
* Flexible attitude
* Ability to collaborate in a diverse project team environment
* Confident presentation ability
* Candidates should be experienced with leading project deliverables and guiding clients through project solicitation and contract management


Corgan creates opportunities for personal and professional growth that bring out the best in ourselves and those around us by sharpening skills, leveraging technology, and encouraging communication. Our commitment to the highest standards of professional ethics is unwavering. Our passion, drive for excellence, and abiding curiosity guide us each day in our interaction with our clients, partners, associates, and with each other. Corgan promotes a healthy work\-life balance by removing obstacles and allowing you to focus on what you love doing, both inside and outside the office.  

Join Corgan and help make amazing places at a place that makes you amazing!  

Base Salary Range: $130,000 \- $210,000 annually – New York locations only  

The estimate range represents the general base salary range of candidates hired in New York only. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include internal equity, experience, education, specialty, and training. In addition, a base salary is not inclusive of total compensation.  

\*Only applications received through our website will be considered. For design positions, please also be sure to upload your portfolio or review of your application will be delayed.\*

* Coordinates with Accounting to set up new projects and prepares invoices for clients.

* Ensures visibility of the company through attendance at public meetings, participation in civic organizations, and participation in public service and charitable activities.

Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

**COMPETENCIES:** To perform this job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies\-

* Zoning, Land Use and Planning expertise
* Detail oriented
* Planning, organizing, and coordinating
* Excellent communications skills \- Listening, understanding and responding
* Teamwork and Cooperation
* Professionalism
* Creativity
* Innovative thinking
* Flexibility

jobs.title: Geospatial Analyst I
jobs.description:
Overview:

Do you enjoy working with the latest industry technology, solving challenges, and contributing to projects that shape communities? NV5 is seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Geospatial Technician I to join our Geomatics team. This position supports a variety of survey, mapping, LiDAR, and geospatial data acquisition projects throughout the Mountain West and Pacific Northwest. The successful candidate will assist with UAV\-based data collection, LiDAR acquisition, point cloud processing, mapping, and geospatial deliverable development for transportation, utility, infrastructure, land development, and public agency projects.


This role is ideal for an individual with a strong technical foundation in geospatial technologies who is looking to build a career in surveying, remote sensing, and geospatial data management.


Responsibilities:
* Perform UAV mission planning and field operations in compliance with FAA regulations.
* Acquire aerial imagery and LiDAR data using unmanned aircraft systems (UAS).
* Process and classify LiDAR point clouds using industry\-standard software.
* Generate digital terrain models (DTMs), digital surface models (DSMs), contours, Orthomosaics, and other geospatial products.
* Assist with georeferencing, quality control, and accuracy assessment of geospatial datasets.
* Support survey and mapping projects through data processing and analysis.
* Prepare mapping exhibits, figures, and technical deliverables.
* Maintain organized project files and metadata.
* Coordinate with surveyors, engineers, GIS professionals, and project managers.
* Perform quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) reviews of geospatial data.
* Assist with field survey operations as required.


Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the essential duties satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Associate's degree or bachelor’s degree in Geomatics, Geography, GIS, Surveying Technology, Remote Sensing, Engineering Technology, or related field.
* Minimum two (2\) years of professional geospatial, surveying, GIS, remote sensing, or LiDAR\-related experience.
* Current FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certification is required.
* Demonstrated experience with LiDAR data acquisition and point cloud processing.
* Experience working with UAV\-collected imagery and geospatial datasets.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel periodically for field assignments.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with mobile mapping systems.
* Experience processing terrestrial, mobile, or aerial LiDAR datasets.
* Knowledge of photogrammetry workflows.
* Familiarity with GNSS and survey control methodologies.
* Experience with transportation, utility, corridor, or land development projects.
* Understanding of coordinate systems, datums, and geodetic principles.
* Experience operating fixed\-wing and/or multi\-rotor UAV platforms.

**Software Experience**


Experience with one or more of the following is preferred:

* Trimble Business Center (TBC)
* ArcGIS Pro
* Civil 3D
* Pix4D
* DJI Terra
* MicroStation
* RIEGL RiScan Pro

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Understanding of survey measurement principles and sources of error.
* Ability to evaluate survey data for completeness, accuracy, and precision.
* Knowledge of boundary evidence, public land survey systems, property corner recovery, and cadastral surveying principles.
* Ability to download, process, review, and edit field\-collected survey data.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining project schedules.
* Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

**Physical Requirements**


The physical demands described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position.

* Ability to perform field work in varying weather conditions.
* Ability to walk uneven terrain and lift up to 40 pounds.
* Ability to travel for project assignments, including overnight travel when required.
* The role may also require operation of UTVs, climbing stairs, prolonged standing, and extended periods of computer work.
* Employees must comply with all company safety policies and project\-specific safety requirements.
